CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH m AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    event_name,
    lower(trim(CAST(member_name AS VARCHAR))) AS lname,
    lower(regexp_replace(CAST(member_name AS VARCHAR), '[^a-z ]', '')) AS letters_only
  FROM member_event_attendance
)
SELECT DISTINCT event_name
FROM m
WHERE lname = 'maya mclean'
